notes.title: Update Notes 9 June 2025 - Random Event Generator!
notes.content:
The major feature added to the game here is the Random Event Generator, which basically allows you to create custom random events for your game world which can impact workers and the game world as a whole. In the future, this will be fleshed out even further, allowing for other random events and effects to happen. 

I want to shout out a few great mod makers in the workshop who have been using the public beta to create a whole heap of random events, which are all easily imported into existing saves and game worlds via the in-game editor:
[list]
[*] Random Events Pack: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3484902651
[*] Anything Can Happen: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3485483384
[*] Aceverse Random Events Pack: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3485742300
[/list]

Having tried these out in some mods, they really add a ton of life to the game world. 

Other new changes: 
[list]
[*] Added Venue Importer to editor
[*] Added Promotion importer to editor
[*] Added Titles importer to editor
[*] Titles will go from inactive to active on their creation date
[*] Relationships wont appear for workers that haven't debuted yet
[*] Allowed importers to work with Workshop files
[*] Fixed bug where AI promotions would eventually stop creating storylines
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 12 Aug 2024 - Contract Rewrite!
notes.content:
A long awaited, long requested addition today - The game now has added a much deeper contract system! I recommend going to Edit Database > Helpful Scripts > Auto Set All Contracts if you're seeing promotions suddenly making a lot more money, as this new setup does change the financial balance a fair bit. 

[list]
[*] Contracts are no longer instantaneous for Written contracts, instead a worker will consider and await other offers first, before settling a contract
[*] Workers can now ask for both a monthly wage and a wage per appearance
[*] PPA deals are now 'Informal Agreements', to reflect the indy scene more
[*] Workers can now ask for a share of the attendance gate, a share of the PPV buys, a share of their merch sales, and limited appearances per year
[*] Promotions can allow a worker to take Indy bookings, where they can work for local or regional promotions while still under a written contract
[*] Added Worker filters for In Ring Traits, Personality Traits, and birthplaces
[*] Added ability to set and save custom filters for Workers screen, so you can quickly pull up common searches
[*] All Workers search now also checks contract names and alter ego names
[*] Added Mentorship relationship type
[*] Added optional freetext field where mod makers can write a description for a relationship, to flesh out the game world
[*] Moved Momentum and Morale to be next to each other
[*] Added ability to set segment times with buttons and not just sliders
[*] Added ability to alter the segment length of matches from the booking overview screen
[*] Added ability to alter the length of beats from the angle booking screen
[*] Altered Promotional Wars so they only start at 45 Pop for cult promotions
[*] Fixed bug where autobooker could sometimes book broken segments
[*] Fixed bug where events with multiple days might only trigger on one of the days
[*] Fixed bug where people in stable could be added to an angle multiple times
[*] Fixed bug where people could be booked before their contract started
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 8 Feb - Money updates, Production upddates, Bankruptcy!
notes.content:
[b]It's highly recommended that you run the Auto-Set Network Deals and Auto Set All Worker Contracts. These can be found in Edit Database > Helpful Scripts. [/b]
Back again with our second release of the year!
[list]
[*] Added the ability for a company to go bankrupt, or be bought out by the user if their company is in a dire financial state. 
[*] Rebalanced network deals, production costs, and worker contracts
[*] Promotions will cut their production levels and release workers in order to cut costs when finances are looking bad
[*] Added two new Production options - Marketing and Back Office. Both come with bonuses to attendance and viewership, and are necessary to move up in levels (Regional to Cult, Cult to National etc) 
[*] Updated Production rules, so that instead of applying a multiplier to your segment score, they cap your  final show score. 
[*] Added a financial chart on the All Promotions page, so you can see how each company is doing financially. 
[*] Widened the criteria for when you are at war with another promotion
[*] Heightened the impact of losing a promotional war
[*] Optimised a lot of UI and backend logic, so that the game should feel a lot faster and more responsive
[*] Improved the performance of the Next Day Cycle to be at least twice as fast by my calculations
[*] Added a little pop noise when Next Day cycle is over, for those who like to go do something else while the Next Day is simming. 
[*] Fixed bug with auto set scripts
[*] Fixed bug where buttons were clickable on home screen
[*] Fixed bug where dead people appeared in the top workers in New Game
[*] 
[/list]

Hi all, after a lot of work, I'm happy to announce the game now has workshop support! You can subscribe to workshop mods using the Workshop section of the Game in Steam. (https://steamcommunity.com/app/1157700/workshop/) 

Subscribing to a workshop item will download it to your computer, where you can easily use it by going to New Game and selecting the Workshop tab. 

To upload Game Worlds and/or Image Folders using the Workshop link on the main page of the game, and select your .db file and/or your image folder. Give it a name, a description and an image and you're done!

Please note that Workshop files and folders cannot be modified (your changes would get wiped out every update), and so there is a "Copy to Local Files" button in the workshop section, so you can copy the file locally to edit as you please. 

I hope you enjoy, and please let me know if you come into any issues.

notes.title: Update Notes 24 October - Networks are finally here!
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Networks[/h1]
Networks are how you can show your events to a wider audience. There are three types - TV Networks, PPV Networks and Online Networks, and they can be available in every continent, country and/or region. This replaces the old "distribution" options in the events screen. How big your network is will effect how much workers and the promotion itself gains and loses popularity from booking shows, as well as the income you can make. On the other hand - what you book and who you book will effect the viewership, as ratings are now calculated on a combination of your popularity in the network's regions, as well as segment by segment- based on the popularity of the workers and the segment's rating. This will not break any existing saves, though on first load you may find many promotions scrambling to get network deals, and you should too! A bunch of AI generated networks will appear as soon as the Office loads, if tehre are no networks in that save file. There's a lot of variables here (I think nearly every mechanic in the game was touched in one way or another to make this happen!), and plenty of room for improvement, so if you see anything strange or have any cool ideas please let me know in the Steam Community page, Discord or Twitter. Thank you! 

[b]Other changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an experimental menu to alter skins on the fly, in the Settings dropdown. Note - edits to the default skins will be wiped out on restart
[*] Fixed bug where Angles would only ever have a positive effect

[*] Cleaned up the news page a little
[*] Added a Mark All as Read button on the mail page, and set mail to archive after 18 months
[*] Merged PPV and TV in Finances page to a single revenue item "Network Revenue"
[*] Added a resolution setting, which is remembered by the game when you reopen it. This is accessible in the Settings dropdown
[*] Fixed a few page titles

notes.title: Update Notes 1 Nov
notes.content:
Its the long awaited venues and regions update! 

You now can select a venue for your shows. There are default venues in each region, or you can create venues in the Edit Database section. Each venue has a certain capacity, and there are costs associated with each type of venue and their capacity. 

Workers can now be based in a certain region. When this is the case, it's likely they will ask you to cover their travel costs when hiring them. Travel costs depend on how far the worker has to travel (inter-regional, inter-country, or inter-continental). 

There were some tweaks to attendance calculations, so your attendance may be slightly lower than you are used to. 

There will be more tweaks, additions and changes to venues and regions down the line, so watch this space!
